title: The tinker's book
blurb: A tinker needs a rope, a torch and a sling by tomorrow. His book says how; your hands do the rest.
after: Nothing you made was in a list: the world judged each one from what it was made of and what you did. A book is advice, not a spell.
refines: Do players follow written instructions into their own words? Does the judge rule the same way on recipe words and on paraphrases? Is a failure's reason clear?
goal: Help the tinker with his order

things.name: Odo's book of makings
things.description: A fat little book bound in scorched leather: how Odo makes the things he sells. Pick it up and read it.

things.name: bundle of flax fibres
things.description: A bundle of combed flax, pale and long-fibred, ready for spinning or twisting.

things.name: heap of sawdust
things.description: A small heap of fine sawdust swept up under the bench.

things.name: ash stick
things.description: A straight ash stick about as long as a forearm and a half.

things.name: linen rag
things.description: A clean linen rag, a hand's width wide and an arm long.

things.name: pot of pine pitch
things.description: A small clay pot of thick, sticky pine pitch, warm from the hearth.

things.name: strip of leather
things.description: A strip of supple tanned leather, a forearm long and three fingers wide.

things.name: hank of hemp twine
things.description: A hank of strong hemp twine, several arm-lengths of it.

things.name: hearth fire
things.description: Glowing coals in the brick hearth, kept hot with the bellows.

steps.title: A workshop
cards: …signal. Back with you. This is Odo's workshop: a tinker, who mends what others throw away and makes what they can't buy.
Today is about making things. Nothing here comes from a list: you say what you do, and the world decides if it works.

steps.title: The tinker
cards: That's Odo at the bench, and his daughter Nell. Go and talk to Odo: {Left-click} him, type, press {Enter}.

on_done.text: Help? Hm. Rope, torch, sling, for my round tomorrow. Book's on the table, says how. Use what's on the bench.

on_done.lead: Make Odo a rope, a torch and a sling, and give them to him
on_done.said: Rope, torch, sling, for my round tomorrow.

steps.done: He's lent you his things: taking them isn't stealing. What he asked is in your journal.
help: {Left-click} Odo to talk to him, type something and press {Enter}.

steps.title: The book
cards: Pick up Odo's book from the table.
steps.task: Pick up the book on the table
steps.done: A book is just a thing in your pack, until you read it.
help: {Left-click} the book on the table, or walk up to it and press {E}.

steps.title: Reading
cards: To read a book, open Pack & gear ({I}) and press Read beside it. Or put it in your hand and press {Space}.
Have a look at the rope, then close the book.
steps.done: Each page says what you need, how, and what it's good for, and offers words to try.
help: Press {I}, find the book, and press Read beside it.

steps.title: Making
cards: Now make the rope. Press {T}, then {Tab} until DO is lit, and describe what you do. Stand near the flax, or carry it.
The book gave words to try; here they are:

suggest.text: twist the flax fibres into a rope

steps.task: Make a rope from the flax
steps.done: You made that. It didn't exist until you did, and it's yours now: look at it in your pack.
help: Press {T}, press {Tab} until DO is lit, type 'twist the flax fibres into a rope', press {Enter}.

playtest.do: twist the flax fibres into a rope

try_also: braid the flax into a cord
make a rope out of the flax

steps.title: When it doesn't work
cards: Not everything works, and that's useful too. Try making a rope from the sawdust, and read what the world says.

suggest.text: twist the sawdust into a rope

steps.task: Try to make a rope from the sawdust
steps.done: See? It names what's wrong (sawdust has no long fibres), not the answer. Read the reason when something fails: it tells you what to change.
help: Press {T}, {Tab} to DO, and type 'twist the sawdust into a rope'.

playtest.do: twist the sawdust into a rope

steps.title: In your own words
cards: The torch next. This time the words are yours: say it however you like. The book has a way, if you want it:

suggest.text: wind the linen rag round the end of the ash stick and soak it in the pine pitch to make a torch

steps.task: Make a torch from the stick, the rag and the pitch
steps.done: Good. The world didn't care about the exact words, only what you did with what.
help: You need the ash stick, the linen rag and the pot of pitch: carry them or stand near them.
Describe it in your own words: what goes round what, and what it's soaked in.

playtest.do: wind the linen rag round the end of the ash stick and soak it in the pine pitch to make a torch

try_also: wrap the rag around the stick and dip it in the pitch

steps.title: On your own
cards: Last, the sling, from the leather and the twine. No words this time: the book has the way.
steps.task: Make a sling from the leather and the twine
steps.done: Three things made from what was lying about. That's most of what you'll do here: look at what's to hand, and think.
help: Open the book ({I}, Read) for the sling.
You need the strip of leather and the hemp twine.

playtest.do: make a sling from the strip of leather and the hemp twine

try_also: tie the twine to both ends of the leather strip to make a sling

steps.title: The order
cards: Odo wants them. Give him the rope, the torch and the sling: drag each one from your pack onto him, or say what you do.

suggest.text: give Odo the rope, the torch and the sling

steps.task: Give Odo the rope, the torch and the sling

on_done.text: Hm. Good work. Tighter knots next time. Here's one for you: an old soldier at the ruined smithy up the valley teaches weapons, if you bring him iron.

on_done.lead: An old soldier at the ruined smithy teaches weapon-making for iron.
on_done.said: An old soldier at the ruined smithy up the valley teaches weapons, if you bring him iron.

help: Walk up to Odo and drag the rope, then the torch, then the sling onto him.
Or click him and type: give him the rope, the torch and the sling.

playtest.do: give Odo the rope, the torch and the sling

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
